tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rdo rje phur pa'i mo pra sgrub pa'i zin bris gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//

gu ru pra wā ka ra de ba badzra ku mā ra na maḥ kun rdzob bden pa'i rten 'brel mo// sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis// dben zhing gtsang ma'i gnas dag tu// bal phying ngam ni gzhi ma dkar po'i steng*// nas kyi g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil bri// de steng sder sogs rin chen snod// btsan bshos mkhar thabs byas pa'i steng*// zur gsum rtse rgyal dkar dmar brgyan// g.yas su 'brang rgyas g.yon sman seng*// rgyab tu gsang phyi mdun mtheb skyu// nas dkar bre gang nang du ni// mda' dar dmar po btsug par bya// phud rgod la sogs mchod pa bsham// phye mar shug dud btang na bzang*// sgrub rten me long gtsang ma bcang*// rang nyid yi dam pad 'byung bsgom// gyer bsgom sbrags la 'di skad do// hūm̐: rang nyid yi dam thugs ka nas: 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros: nub phyogs g.ya' spang mtshams shed nas: gsal byed mo yi bdag po ni: btsan rje snying drung btsan po ste: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: kye: bzhengs shig snying klung btsan po bzhengs: sku la dar nag go zu gsol: chibs su smug gu rgab nag 'chib: dbu la bya zhu smug po gsol: phyag na mda' mo bya rgod bsnams: 'phrul gyi me long sked la btsugs: lhab lhab de ni 'phur zhing byon: thol thol de ni smra zhing byon: mo bdag lags pas mo ston cig: pra bdag lags pas pra ston cig: rdzun dang g.yo sgyu ma mdzad cig: sgrib med wal ler bstan du gsol: nga yis 'bod par ma chad dam: khyod kyang 'ong bar ma chad dam: pra bdag de ni pra la byon: de ring snang srid sa ler ston: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tiṣṭha lhan: oṃ a kā sogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ btsan rgod snying drung btsan po'i zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: btsan rgod snying drung btsan po ni: sku ni smug la dar nag gsol: chibs su smug gu rgab nag 'chib:

bya zhu gsol zhing mda' dar bsnams: snang gsal me long sked la btsugs: 'phur zhing g.yon nas thol thol smra: mo lha pra yi bdag po khyed: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes gyur cig: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar: deng 'dir bdag gis mo bsgrub na: bzang ngan gnyis kyi mthong chod la: legs nyes gnyis kyi shan phyes la: rno mthong mo yi dngos grub stsol: de ltar mchod cing las bcol nas: btsan rje rang gi mdun du gnas: gsal byed mo rnams ston par 'gyur: oṃ da na ra tsa phaṭa: da na ra tsa phaṭa: ni du ra tsa phaṭa: du pa ra tsa phaṭa: pra mo ston swā hā: sngags de rab ni khri phrag gcig /'bring ni bdun stong tha ma yang*// sum stong bzlas pas 'grub pa ste// me long gtsang ma sngags dar byang*// dus ni zhag gcig rang gis bsgrub// dam tshig mi gtsang ba la 'dzem// yugs sar mi 'grogs yugs sa yi/ kha 'phro gos yugs 'dzem pa dang: mi la mi smra shin tu gsang: sgrub pa thon nas mo lha de// 'od zhu me long de la bstim// mda' dang de nyid rten rdzas bcang*// me long rgyun du 'chang bar bya// de nas mo ni nam 'debs dus// 'dzom na btsan bshos mda' dar sogs// thams cad sgrub dus bzhin du bsham// phye mar phud rgod la sogs bsham// de tsam rgyas par ma 'phrod na: mda' dar mo nas phye mar bsham// sgrub dus bzhin du gyer nas bsgrub// bsnyen pa yang ni cung zad bzla// de lta bu yang ma 'dzom na// mo nas mchod pa'i rdzas su bsham// kye: bzhengs shig nas/ sa ler ston: zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung gi tshig shlo ka bzhi'i spyan 'dren bya/ de nas bsnyen pa cung zad bya// de ltar rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang*// sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas// me long rgyas btab bgegs rnams bskrad// oṃ badzra tsandha pra ta ya: de nas sgrub sngags brgya rtsa bzla:

oṃ da na ra tsa phaṭa: da na ra tsa phaṭa: ni du ra tsa phaṭa: du pa ra tsa phaṭa: pra mo ston swā hā: de nas mo kha 'byed pa'i sngags// ci 'grub bzlas la me long gi /gsal ngos de la phu btab bo// oṃ a me ka kha ya: ma kra ka kha ya: tsa tra ka kha ya: spos dang phye mar gsur dud bya// de nas rang gi gang shes kyi// rdil mo shwa mo cho le'i mo// ju thig la sogs mo yi rigs// mo ni gang shes gzhung ltar btab// mkha' 'gro sde bcu yin na ni// mkha' 'gro'i mo brdar rjes su ni// 'di byas de nas mo btab bo// mo ni 'debs dus me long ste// rang gi rke la btags par bya// rgyun du rke la btags pa 'am// gtsang sar sbas sam gwa 'ur bcug /de la gzhan gyi lag mi 'grim// dgos dus blangs nas sngags kyis btab// gal te mo lha mi gzhug cing*// lan re tsam las mi 'debs nas// rgyun du rtsub chag 'ong dogs na// dang po bsgrubs nas btsan rje de// rang gnas badzra muḥ sa gshegs la// dgos dus spyan drangs mo btab nas// slar yang rang gnas gshegs gsol bya// me long la ni mi bstim mo// mo 'di rgyun du mkho ba na// me long la bstims rgyun du 'chang*// nyal te glo bur mo nas kyang*// med par phreng mo 'debs dgos na// spyan 'dren shlo ka bzhi po// mo brdar tshul du brjod nas kyang*// bgegs bskrad sngags de tshar bdun ni// me long mi gsal ngos der btab// sgrub sngags nyer gcig tsam du 'don// mo kha 'byed sngags nyer gcig tsam// bzlas pa me long gsal ngos btab// de nas phreng mo gzhung ltar 'debs// yid kyis mchod pas mchod par dmigs// ja sogs phor kha'i mchod pa la// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i rjes// snying drung btsan po mchod cig brjod// phur pa yang gsang spu gri yi// las tshogs o rgyan rjes mdzad pa'i// rten 'brel mo pra'i sgrub pa 'di// gzhung tshig go bar dka' mthong nas// gnas bskor la sogs 'gro mkhan la// mo rno shes pa gal che bas// ma 'ongs 'gro la phan sems kyis// sngags 'chang rā ga a sya yis// 'di bris nyes 'gal ci mchis pa// chos bdag dang ni btsan la bshags// dge bas 'gro ba thams cad la// nyes dgu kun las thar nas kyang*// legs dgu kun dang phrad par shog
